description: Renovate's woodpecker manager reads every step `image:` in .woodpecker, and docker:pinDigests keeps each one on an immutable digest.
A tag can be repointed at new code retroactively, and these pipelines hold the credentials that write your registry and your state branch.
Renovate maintains both halves once pinned: it bumps the tag and the @sha256 digest beside it in one reviewed PR. Renovate runs against Gitea and Forgejo as a self-hosted bot.
